widgets_values:
EXPERIMENTAL — CPU/schema checked; no model-weight/GPU quality acceptance.

Matches the source T8 contract: 3 steps -> denoised_output -> learned 2x -> Reconcile -> fresh noise -> T8 refine 5 steps. This is NOT the last five sigmas of the first schedule.

One visible external segment, automatically repeated by Sequence Start/End. Completed HIGH State feeds both stages of the next segment. LOW explicitly projects only its reference; HIGH keeps original State resolution. Decode only after both segments. Neutral prompt, loader selections reused; choose your own media and prompts. Main Review/Take/Run Storage is not part of this adapter.

AUTOMATIC VERSION: set Chunks and Review mode in Sequence Start. Sequence End replays the editable external graph through Core graph expansion, stores immutable CPU Takes with safetensors + JSON, and provides Continue/Retry/Finish Queue buttons. Separate experimental review store; no Main storage migration. Do not put Save/Encoder or unrelated output nodes inside the loop.
